title: Gen8 Label (5-plane ontology firewall)
description: PROMPT 002A §8. The five label planes MUST NOT be collapsed into one good/bad label.

planes.description: Each plane is independent and separately sourced.

observedSignal.description: OBSERVED_SIGNAL — directly observable facts (e.g. OCR text present, language, entity mention).

evidenceBasedInference.description: EVIDENCE_BASED_INFERENCE — supported inference with provenance; never presented as observed fact.

policyClassification.description: POLICY_CLASSIFICATION — product/user policy (e.g. Positive Exposure category). NOT a truth claim.

personalFit.description: PERSONAL_FIT — alignment to a specific user goal/algorithm. Per-user, never global truth.

spiritualOrSymbolicInterpretation.description: SPIRITUAL_OR_SYMBOLIC_INTERPRETATION — interpretive only; MUST NOT affect Truth/Evidence or the score.
